boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 91 starts with stacked `7` and `5` chambers, but the real choke point is the center elevator that appears after the top chamber shrinks. Clear the packed left wall first, drain the `7` chamber second, and then clean the numbered cyan lane before the last side pieces leave.
landmarks: Block Out Level 91 starts with stacked `7` and `5` chambers, but the real choke point is the center elevator that appears after the top chamber shrinks.
Clear the packed left wall first, drain the `7` chamber second, and then clean the numbered cyan lane before the last side pieces leave.
The board mixes Purple, Green, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: If the left wall is still crowded, the `7` chamber is not ready.
The cyan countdown lane is the part that actually locks the late game.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Soften the left wall by clearing the green ladder and the yellow column beside it.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Free the small red square near the middle so the center shaft is not boxed in later.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Start shrinking the upper `7` chamber only after the left wall is lighter.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Let the center elevator open and clear the cyan countdown lane that appears between the chambers.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the lower `5` chamber once the shaft is no longer blocked by the yellow and red vertical pieces.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the remaining red and green side pieces after the middle lane is empty.

failurePoints: Shrinking the `7` chamber before the left wall has opened enough room for the center shaft.
Ignoring the cyan countdown lane and jumping straight from the `7` chamber to the `5` chamber.
